profile.Name: Stubs Momuso
profile.Personality: Touchy about the way he talks. He mispronounces words and bristles when anyone notices. Funny when he forgets to be self-conscious.
profile.Backstory: A Scorchlander drifter in the Swamp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Mispronounces words without noticing; gets defensive about it; asks if you are eyeballing him.
